title: dispatch
description: Input schema for the lernie built-in `dispatch` tool (ARCH §2.5, §3.3, §3.4 — v0.4 Phase 2). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array.

role.description: Subagent role to dispatch. Must resolve to <conv-repo>/souls/<role>.md and be present in the per-repo providers.yaml `roles:` block (ARCH §4.3). v0.4 Phase 2 supports `worker`; future roles slot in by name as the dispatch CLI grows.

goal.description: Per-call goal text. Written verbatim to the subagent's goal.md on its dispatch commit (ARCH §2.3 step 2 / §2.8). The subagent reads its goal there; the dispatching agent does not see the subagent's intermediate work — only the terminal compacted result, returned later via `await(handle)`.
